note: Coverage and fees are the twin's arithmetic inputs, not quotes. They were compiled from published sources on the date above and drift with sanctions, data-localisation rules and rate cards. Re-check against each provider's own pages before acting on a refusal or a cost.
minor_units_note: Every amount in this application is integer minor units of one currency, so 'cents' means 1/100 for USD, 1/1 for JPY and 1/1000 for BHD. See minor_units.

exponent_overrides.note: Providers occasionally deviate from ISO 4217 for a currency in a specific API. Left empty rather than guessed. If a live provider rejects an amount for one currency, put its code and exponent here instead of changing the arithmetic.

rails.name: paypal
rails.label: PayPal Checkout
rails.settlement_note: A hold, reserve or limitation can outlast 180 days under PayPal's User Agreement, so money that arrives is not necessarily money that is available.

unavailable.TR: consumer service stopped in 2016 over local data-server requirements

cannot_receive.AM: sending only; a recipient account cannot hold or withdraw
cannot_receive.GE: sending only; a recipient account cannot hold or withdraw

no_local_withdrawal.KZ: sending works, no local bank withdrawal
no_local_withdrawal.QA: sending only, no Qatari bank withdrawal

no_domestic.IN: international receipts only; no domestic transfers

rails.name: local_transfer
rails.label: Local bank transfer
rails.settlement_note: Domestic rails usually clear in days, not seconds, and a transfer can be recalled by its sender. Verify the business effect before calling it settled.

coverage.note: No verified country map. This stands in for whichever domestic rail the deployment actually wires — UPI, SEPA, PIX, NIP, IBFT and so on — and refuses nothing until its adapter declares its own coverage.

rails.name: card_gateway
rails.label: Card gateway
rails.settlement_note: Scheme fees vary by card class and country. The rates here are an editable estimate, not a contract.

coverage.note: No verified country map. A deployment supplying a real gateway adapter should declare the countries it clears into.
